title: puccinellia distans subsp. sevangensis
intro: Puccinellia distans subsp. sevangensis, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from oxidative damage. The therapeutic actions of Puccinellia distans subsp. sevangensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and possess hepatoprotective and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
